description: Find, or find and change, with the Find/Change dialog's full criteria: text, GREP, glyph, object, colour or transliterate searches; Find Format and Change Format attributes; search scope (document, all documents, story, to end of story, selection); and the search options (locked, hidden and parent-page items, footnotes, case, whole word, kana, width, diacritics, kashidas, backwards). A saved query can supply the criteria. Returns the count and the first matches

action.description: find only counts and lists matches; change replaces them (Change All)

change.description: What to change matches to. Fields by mode: text and grep take text and format; transliterate takes characterType and format; glyph takes font, fontStyle and glyphId; object takes objectStyle, fillColor, strokeColor, fillTint, strokeTint and strokeWeight; color takes swatch and tint

characterType.description: Transliterate: the character type to find or change to

font.description: Glyph: font, as "Family\tStyle" or a family name

format.description: Change Format: apply these attributes to the matches

capitalization.description: Case: normal, all_caps, small_caps or cap_to_small_cap

fillColor.description: Text colour: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

font.description: Font, as "Family\tStyle" or a family name

position.description: Position: normal, superscript, subscript or an OpenType position

strokeColor.description: Text stroke colour: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

glyphId.description: Glyph: glyph ID (GID) in the font

text.description: Replacement text; GREP replacements may use $0-$9 and found-text metacharacters

find.description: What to find. Fields by mode: text and grep take text and format; transliterate takes characterType and format; glyph takes font, fontStyle and glyphId; object takes objectStyle, fillColor, strokeColor, fillTint, strokeTint and strokeWeight; color takes swatch and tint

characterType.description: Transliterate: the character type to find or change to

font.description: Glyph: font, as "Family\tStyle" or a family name

format.description: Find Format: only match text with these attributes

capitalization.description: Case: normal, all_caps, small_caps or cap_to_small_cap

fillColor.description: Text colour: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

font.description: Font, as "Family\tStyle" or a family name

position.description: Position: normal, superscript, subscript or an OpenType position

strokeColor.description: Text stroke colour: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

glyphId.description: Glyph: glyph ID (GID) in the font

text.description: Text or GREP expression to find (metacharacters such as ^p, ^t, \d and (?i) work as in the Find/Change dialog)

frameId.description: For scope story or story_to_end: a text frame of the story

keepCriteria.description: Leave the criteria and options in Find/Change afterwards (for Find Next and the other run_find_change_command commands); default resets them

mode.description: The search: text, grep, glyph, object (frames by attributes), color (a swatch on text and objects, Edit > Find/Change for colour) or transliterate (Japanese character types and digits)

options.description: Search options (the Find/Change dialog buttons); each applies only to the modes that have it

includeHiddenLayers.description: Include Hidden Layers and Hidden Objects

includeLockedLayers.description: Include Locked Layers and Locked Objects (finding only)

includeLockedStories.description: Include Locked Stories, such as checked-in InCopy stories (finding only)

objectType.description: Type of frames to search (object, color)

query.description: Load a saved query (user or Adobe-supplied) of this mode as the criteria; find, change and options given here are added on top

name.description: Query name, as in the Find/Change dialog Query menu

scope.description: Search: document, all_documents, story (storyId, frameId, or the selection's story), story_to_end (from frameId's text or the cursor), or selection (the selected text). Object and color searches take document or all_documents

storyId.description: For scope story: the story id

name: run_find_change
title: Run Find Change
